correctness.rationale: Define the forest complex of K5 as the graphic matroid independence complex on ten edge vertices (acyclic edge subsets); face counts by cardinality are exactly 10,45,110,125. On strict nonempty forest chains, vertex relabelings preserve ranks, so each chain orbit gives a genuine integral quotient Delta-cell with usual alternating boundary. Independently enumerated all 2^10 edge subsets and all 120 S5 actions, finding quotient cell counts (9,33,49,25) and boundary d^2=0. An independent sparse integer unit reduction (rather than trusting the source Smith log) gives 8 pivots in degree1, 25 in degree2, 24 in degree3, with exactly one surviving H0 and one H3 generator, no torsion. From a quotient one-skeleton spanning tree, 25 remaining generators were independently eliminated by triangular two-cell relators (stages 15,8,2), proving pi1=1. Hurewicz and simply-connected Whitehead imply |F(K5)|/S5 ~ S3. These computations exhaust the natural finite K5 instance, not arbitrary Kn.
